mr-midshipman-easy: Captain Marryat's comic naval classic follows Jack Easy, a young gentleman who joins the navy believing all men are equal — and learns how wrong he is. Through battles, storms, and the rough education of shipboard life, Jack grows into a true officer. Funny, exciting, and full of authentic sea detail from an author who lived it.
rosy: Mrs. Molesworth — the beloved Victorian author of Carrots and The Cuckoo Clock — tells the story of little Rosy with her usual warmth and understanding of children. A gentle tale of family life, small adventures, and growing up, written in the graceful style that made her books nursery classics. Young readers and their parents will find it sweet, old-fashioned company.
